description: Testing PDF reading, extraction, and generation capabilities with objective verification of output.

evals.name: extract-text-from-invoice
evals.prompt: Extract all line items and total amount from this invoice PDF. Format as a table with: item name, quantity, unit price, and total price.
evals.expected_output: Structured table extracted from PDF with accurate line items and totals matching the source document. All numbers should be correctly transcribed.
expectations: Extracts all line items without omission

evals.name: generate-report-pdf
evals.prompt: Create a PDF report with: title 'Q4 2026 Sales Report', executive summary (2 paragraphs), a table of sales by region, and a conclusion. Format: standard 8.5x11 inch page with 1-inch margins.
evals.expected_output: Valid PDF file with all requested sections, proper formatting, readable fonts, and correct page dimensions.
expectations: PDF is valid and opens in standard readers
Contains all requested sections in correct order
Table is properly formatted with alignment

evals.name: merge-multiple-pdfs
evals.prompt: Merge these 3 PDF files into a single document: cover.pdf, content.pdf, appendix.pdf. Preserve original formatting and add a table of contents referencing page numbers.
evals.expected_output: Single merged PDF with all pages in correct order, table of contents with accurate page numbers, and no loss of formatting or text.
expectations: All pages present in correct order
Table of contents created with accurate page numbers
Original formatting preserved from each input file
PDF is valid and opens cleanly
